portals.name: Jincheng official land registry / map sources
portals.operator: Official city, regional or national authority as scoped in the observations
portals.observation: City-specific Jincheng registry presence is directly confirmed by the official municipal registration-center portal. Its cadastral-map query guide is an image-based instructions page; no account, address, unit number, title number, search, or map selection was used. No public geometry-only service schema or safe allowlist was verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official Jincheng Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center identifies itself as a municipal registration institution under the Jincheng Planning and Natural Resources Bureau; the official city government portal confirms the municipal jurisdiction. Queue coordinates at 35.5000 N, 112.8480 E place this at 晋城, Shanxi. The center provides registration services but does not establish public parcel-vector access.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public geometry-only parcel response was verified.
